content.title: Spurs vs. Nuggets: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (4/4/26)
content.text: The San Antonio Spurs (59–18) face the Denver Nuggets (49–28) today at Ball Arena, as both teams play the first of their last five games of the regular season. Denver and San Antonio run it back next weekend in the season finale in San Antonio. The Spurs have won 11 straight and remain in the chase for the top spot in the Western Conference, trailing the first-place Oklahoma City Thunder by just two games. They come off a critical 118–99 win over the ascending LA Clippers on Thursday, despite being without Victor Wembanyama, responding with a balanced attack and stout defense. De’Aaron Fox led with 22 points while Stephon Castle added 20 and Dylan Harper chipped in 19. Wembanyama returns to the lineup for today’s matchup against the fourth-place Denver Nuggets, who’ve won seven straight and are just a game behind the third-place Los Angeles Lakers. The Nuggets have a real shot at the third seed with Luka Doncic sidelined for the rest of the regular season. Denver comes in off a 130–117 win over the Utah Jazz on Wednesday, with Nikola Jokic recording a triple-double and Jamal Murray leading with 37 after knocking down 10 three-pointers. Expect a high-scoring battle to the wire between these two potent offenses, with a slight edge going to San Antonio, given its current momentum.
